mapper.sql: SELECT o.*,o.username_snapshot AS account_name,o.user_name_snapshot AS recipient_name,(SELECT count(*) FROM issue_order_line l WHERE l.issue_order_id=o.id) AS line_count,(SELECT string_agg(l.material_name,'、' ORDER BY l.line_no) FROM issue_order_line l WHERE l.issue_order_id=o.id) AS material_names,(SELECT string_agg(l.batch_code,'、' ORDER BY l.line_no) FROM issue_order_line l WHERE l.issue_order_id=o.id) AS batch_codes,(SELECT string_agg(l.quantity::text||' '||l.unit,' / ' ORDER BY l.line_no) FROM issue_order_line l WHERE l.issue_order_id=o.id) AS quantity_summary FROM issue_order o

where.if: AND (o.issue_no ILIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '\' OR o.project_no ILIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '\' OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM issue_order_line l WHERE l.issue_order_id=o.id AND (l.material_name ILIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '\' OR l.material_code ILIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '\')))
AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM issue_order_line l WHERE l.issue_order_id=o.id AND (l.material_name ILIKE #{materialPattern} ESCAPE '\' OR l.material_code ILIKE #{materialPattern} ESCAPE '\'))
AND (o.user_name_snapshot ILIKE #{userPattern} ESCAPE '\' OR o.username_snapshot ILIKE #{userPattern} ESCAPE '\')

mapper.select: SELECT l.*,COALESCE((SELECT sum(r.quantity) FROM return_order_line r WHERE r.issue_order_line_id=l.id),0) AS returned_quantity,l.quantity-COALESCE((SELECT sum(r.quantity) FROM return_order_line r WHERE r.issue_order_line_id=l.id),0) AS returnable_quantity,t.transaction_no,t.before_quantity,t.after_quantity FROM issue_order_line l JOIN stock_transaction t ON t.issue_line_id=l.id WHERE l.issue_order_id=#{id} ORDER BY l.line_no
ORDER BY o.created_at DESC,o.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
WHERE b.item_id=#{id} AND b.quantity>0 ORDER BY b.received_at,b.id LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
